ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TruckSOS uses your location to attach your truck's position to your breakdown announcement, so nearby mechanics can find you on the map.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: TruckSOS uses the camera so you can photograph the breakdown and attach the photo to your announcement or send it in a conversation.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TruckSOS accesses your photo library so you can attach photos to your breakdown announcements and conversations.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: TruckSOS saves photos received in conversations to your photo library, only when you tap the download button.
